annotations.title: Check a proposed use against exclusives

description: Check a proposed use (a description, plus an optional use category or 2022 NAICS code) against a center's verified lease.exclusive_use and lease.prohibited_uses facts (from doc_verify_facts or doc_abstract_lease; each must pass fact_validate). Deterministic and textual: a restriction is a potential conflict when it shares a use category with the proposed use (FactLot's published use-category vocabulary, matched on keywords, the category given and NAICS codes) or shares words with it (two or more, or every significant word of the restriction). Each hit is labelled "potential conflict — needs human review" and returns the controlling quote and citation, the categories and words that matched, and the exclusive's carve-outs, flagging those that mention the proposed use. FactLot does not interpret the lease, decide whether a carve-out applies, or give legal conclusions; an empty result does not mean there is no conflict. Superseded facts are ignored.

facts.description: Verified lease.exclusive_use and lease.prohibited_uses facts for the center, from doc_verify_facts or doc_abstract_lease (each must pass fact_validate). Facts another fact supersedes are ignored; other predicates are skipped.

items.description: A FactLot fact, as doc_verify_facts or doc_abstract_lease returned it.

category.description: Optional use category id from FactLot's vocabulary (spec/schemas/vocabularies/use-categories.json), e.g. coffee.

naics.description: Optional 2022 NAICS code, 2 to 6 digits; a shorter code matches every category under it (7225 matches restaurants and coffee shops).

text.description: The proposed use as described, e.g. "coffee shop selling espresso drinks and pastries".

name: doc_check_use_conflict
title: Check a proposed use against exclusives
